text: 10月12日，香港交易所集团行政总裁陈翊庭发布新一期CEO网志。值得注意的是，陈翊庭本次发声信息量巨大，其中包括还将就优化特专科技公司和GEM上市制度展开咨询；吸引更多国际企业来港进行主要或第二上市；与内地合作伙伴正在进行将房地产信托基金（REIT）纳入沪深港通和人民币股票柜台纳入港股通的准备工作；正积极研究延长衍生产品的夜市交易时间，至于延长股票市场交易时间，香港交易所将从引领市场讨论开始，寻找市场各方都能接受的方案。（证券时报）
text_en: On October 12, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing CEO Bonnie Chan published a new CEO blog post. Notably, Chan's remarks carried a huge amount of information, including that consultations will be held on optimizing the listing regime for specialist technology companies and GEM; attracting more international companies to list in Hong Kong for primary or secondary listings; ongoing preparatory work with mainland partners to include REITs in Stock Connect and RMB stock counters in Southbound Stock Connect; and actively studying extending after-hours trading for derivatives, while for extending stock market trading hours, HKEX will start by leading market discussion to find a plan acceptable to all market parties. (Securities Times)
